name: Tarong
description: The Tarongs were large sentient avians from the twin worlds of Iri and Disim in the Epidimi system. Notably skilled mimics, Tarongs were typically talkative and friendly people. They were fond of space travel, gems, and protocol droids.

data.name: Tarong
data.races: Hybridized from species from Iri and Disim
data.distinctions: Quadrupedal avians, keen vision, vocal mimicry
